title: tacular-omics: Install the tacular-omics proteomics packages together
description: tacular-omics is a meta-package that installs the tacular-omics core Python packages for mass-spectrometry proteomics (tacular, psimodpy, unimodpy, uniprotptmpy, fastatacular, pefftacular, mzmlpy, tdfpy, peptacular, paftacular and spxtacular) at a set of released versions tested together, each pinned with a floor and a major-version cap. It has no functionality of its own beyond reporting the installed member versions. It requires Python 3.12 or later.
